arguments.label: Compute available.json
arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/stock.json scratch/reserved.json > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 -c "
import json
s=json.load(open('scratch/stock.json'))
r=json.load(open('scratch/reserved.json'))
out=[{'sku':k,'available':s[k]-r.get(k,0)} for k in sorted(s)]
json.dump(out,open('scratch/available.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
" && cat scratch/available.json && md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5
